external-mode.description: Resolution to use for the external display (e.g. 1920x1080)

external-output.description: External (TV/monitor) display output name from xrandr (e.g. HDMI-1, DP-1)

external-position.description: Where to place the external display relative to the laptop screen

internal-output.description: Internal (laptop) display output name from xrandr (e.g. LVDS-1, eDP-1)
